right.name: side tabs
right.use_when: Investment thesis pillars: bold claim + evidence -> so what -> implication (35+ words per pillar)
right.dont_use_when: Short facts or one-liners (use pill_rows); a process (use chevrons)

picked.name: bullets
picked.use_when: Numbered commentary beside an exhibit: bold lead-in + evidence + so what, 2-6 points
picked.dont_use_when: The main exhibit of a page (pick a chart, table or diagram); more than 2 bullet blocks on one slide

why: 3 short text lines on approvals and timing beside the proposal; bullets fit commentary, not a sequenced process

message: 13 parties contacted narrowed to few proposals with most recent price indications of $28-31

block.about: indicated price per share by party

right.name: table
right.use_when: Labelled numbers that need exact reading: comps, precedents, sources & uses, deal terms, one-way sensitivities (down / base / up), KPI lists with change vs prior period, requirements with detail
right.dont_use_when: A trend over time (use a chart); ranking many players on one metric (use bar); 3-6 headline numbers with no extra columns (use stat_strip)

picked.name: bar
picked.use_when: Ranking players by one metric (target navy, the rest grey)
picked.dont_use_when: A time series (use column); 2-3 scenario values such as a one-way sensitivity down / base / up (use table)

why: 3 parties, one metric ($ per share), chartable unit; bar ranks the price indications, table loses the visual gap

right.name: Segment table with side tabs + commentary column
right.use_when: Segment or business-unit financials with explanation per segment

picked.name: Projections table + numbered commentary
picked.use_when: Management case or business plan pages
picked.dont_use_when: Historicals only with no story to tell; more than 8 commentary points

why: 5 commentary lines keyed to cost lines in a projection table; lettered commentary per precedent

right.name: Landscape page: logo wall by segment beside a chart

picked.name: logo row
picked.use_when: Peers, buyers, sponsors, customers or tenants as logo tiles (target highlighted)
picked.dont_use_when: Players that need numbers beside them (use a bar chart with the target navy)

why: credential tombstones grouped by sub-sector, 3 lines; logo tombstone grid per precedent
